description: This file contains unit tests for the DataAssetBackend project. Specifically, it tests database-backed asset copy and lineage behaviors, including ensuring that copying assets creates new IDs without mutating the source, and that lineage queries return correct data based on copy operation IDs.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyAndLineageTests
classes.description: Contains integration tests for asset copying and lineage behaviors in the database-backed system.

methods.name: Copy_asset_creates_new_asset_id_and_does_not_mutate_source
methods.description: Tests that copying an asset creates a new asset with a different ID, and the source remains unchanged.

methods.name: Copy_creates_lineage_and_query_by_copy_operation_id_returns_result
methods.description: Verifies that copying an asset creates lineage records that can be queried by copy operation ID.

methods.name: Lineage_query_without_any_filters_returns_400
methods.description: Ensures that querying lineage without filters returns a 400 Bad Request status.
